name: 7SEEDS
description: Shy Natsu awakens as part of a group chosen to ensure the survival of humanity. Together, they have to survive on a changed Earth.

videos.title: Spring Begins
videos.overview: Along with three others, Natsu wakes up with no idea what's happened. The four of them reach an island and try to figure out a way to survive.

videos.title: Insects Awaken
videos.overview: Convinced that Botan has kidnapped them, Natsu and Arashi sneak out of camp and run into another survivor. Finally, Botan reveals what she knows.

videos.title: Light Snow
videos.overview: Natsu's clumsiness indirectly leads Team Summer B to the rest of their group. Her memories help them figure out their location, and their next moves.

videos.title: Autumn Begins
videos.overview: Arashi, Natsu and Semimaru stumble upon the Team Autumn settlement in the former Kobe region. They seem to be thriving, but their leaders are tyrants.

videos.title: Heavy Snow
videos.overview: In the ruins of Tokyo, Natsu, Arashi and Semimaru meet the sole survivor of Team Winter. Team Spring reaches Mt. Ogino Fuji and finds Natsu's message.

videos.title: Grain Rain
videos.overview: Aramaki joins Team Spring, despite Fujiko's doubts. Hana decides to search for Arashi after hearing that Aramaki met someone who fits his description.

videos.title: Winter Solstice
videos.overview: Hana and her companions discover a massive underground shelter. They find a survivor’s diary and learn the cruel fate of those who took refuge there.

videos.title: Summer Solstice
videos.overview: Hana's group and the Team Autumn survivors find the Spring settlement destroyed and abandoned. Momotaro wakes up among strangers.

videos.title: Lesser Heat
videos.overview: To survive, Hana and the others work together with Team Summer A. On the ship, Hotaru's cousin Hibari tells Natsu that Hotaru is slowly dying.

videos.title: Cold Dew
videos.overview: Ango recalls his harsh upbringing in the program and the brutal graduation test that winnowed the survivors down to the final Team Summer A members.

videos.title: Greater Heat
videos.overview: Hana becomes convinced that Ango will kill her if she stays in the village. Natsu and the others make landfall near the former Autumn settlement.

videos.title: End of Heat
videos.overview: Ryo orders Hana to join him in searching for a water source underground, putting her in a vulnerable position. In the caves, Ango recalls Shigeru.

videos.title: Frost Descends
videos.overview: Team Summer A banishes Ango and Ryo as Haru and the others mourn the missing Hana. Aramaki leaves the settlement believing she is still alive.

videos.title: Summer Begins
videos.overview: Expecting a trap, Ango and Ryo find and observe Team Summer B, but they are unexpectedly welcomed by the easygoing group.

videos.title: Grain in Ear
videos.overview: The two newcomers help Team Summer B. As they get to know the group, Ryo doubts their ability to survive. Ango begins to see Natsu as Shigeru.

videos.title: Autumnal Equinox
videos.overview: The carefree group enjoys life at sea, but Ryo tests their survival skills. Natsu reveals that Team Summer B is for dropouts, angering Ango.

videos.title: Vernal Equinox
videos.overview: Suspicious, Botan searches Ryo and Ango's belongings while the others look for Arashi. Elsewhere, another survivor learns about the wilderness.

videos.title: White Dew
videos.overview: Team Summer B gets stuck in a bed of dense algae. they find a large ship and investigate, but Botan is wary. Stranded, Arashi sees the ship's kite.

videos.title: Winter Begins
videos.overview: The team members are separated after the ship's sudden movement. Arashi makes his way to help as Botan's group makes a discovery.

videos.title: Lesser Cold
videos.overview: Ango's hallucinations lead to perilous situations for him and Arashi. Semimaru has a brush with death while Natsu gathers her courage.

videos.title: Grain Full
videos.overview: A sanctuary in nature becomes a trap for small mammals and humans alike. Meanwhile, an iron-eating bacteria begins to spread throughout the ship.

videos.title: Rain Water
videos.overview: Fujiko and Chisa reunite with Hana. On the ship, the missiles begin launch prep while Team Summer B learns about Ango's past and the test.

videos.title: Greater Cold
videos.overview: Hana readjusts to other humans. Team Summer B works together to manually disable the missiles, but a series of passcodes complicates the process.

videos.title: Pure Brightness
videos.overview: Problems persist in the ship as the spreading bacteria begins attacking. The missile countdown continues as the team makes a mad dash to exit.

language: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, English, Japanese
